authority: Latest founder direction: source-led academic study; remove student doctor-review gate; preserve clinical draft protections

gates.original_requirement: Coverage: every essential subject/unit/topic maps to an outcome and reviewer; no unmapped mandatory area.
gates.scope: 15 subject introductions; 60 named teaching concepts. Essential BDS/official exam coverage remains incomplete.

gates.original_requirement: Content source: each factual claim points to authoritative edition/year/section or verified official notice.
gates.scope: Per-unit links to inspected primary publishers; title, organization, edition/undated year, section, check date and content version recorded. This is an AI research check, not professional sign-off.

gates.original_requirement: Freshness: content older than configured review interval is flagged for inspection before continued clinical use.
gates.scope: Sources checked 2026-11-24. Legacy high-risk clinical content is still draft; source checks do not authorize clinical use.
gates.evidence: Source checked_on and content_version; immutable content hashes

gates.original_requirement: Clinical sign-off: independent qualified reviewer sign-off mandatory before clinical content publication.
gates.scope: No independent clinical approval claimed. No procedural, drug-dose or individualized treatment protocol is released; legacy clinical gates remain enforced.

gates.original_requirement: MCQ unambiguity: each item has one defensible best option in its stated context; other options explained.
gates.scope: Single keyed answer and option rationales; original academic questions. Clinical and empirical psychometric validation not claimed.
gates.evidence: Each unit answer, explanation, rationales and source_ids; native grading QA

gates.original_requirement: Clinical safety: high-risk emergency content flags red flags and escalation; no unsafe free-form treatment instructions.
gates.scope: Emergency chapter teaches readiness and vocabulary only. No dosing, treatment algorithm or technique. It explicitly distinguishes theory from practical training.

gates.original_requirement: Diagram accuracy: anatomy image labels/orientation checked by expert, alt text accurate and licensing recorded.
gates.scope: No new anatomical image is released. Original unavailable clinical illustrations are not certified by this change.

gates.original_requirement: Misconception correction: wrong answers generate explanation and linked remedial lesson, not only correct label.
gates.scope: Incorrect selections show verified-source concept explanation and the selected distractor rationale; all option rationales available. First mistakes link back to the relevant concept.

gates.original_requirement: Fresh retrieval: learning checked on unseen questions, not only repeats or answer exposure.
gates.scope: Four different application stems follow four teaching checks per chapter; two different retrieval questions follow later. Open study bundles are not secure unseen exam banks.

gates.original_requirement: Delayed retention: configured 1/7/30-day follow-up retrieval probes store scores separately from immediate attempts.
gates.scope: One next-day check with two fresh questions, server-locked until 24 hours after saved completion; scores stored separately. Fresh 7/30-day probes are not yet authored.
gates.evidence: exam_study_access; independent recall course IDs; native delayed access tests

gates.original_requirement: Confidence calibration: user-reported confidence compared with performance, never mistaken for mastery.
gates.scope: No confidence score is collected or represented as mastery in this introductory release.
gates.evidence: No confidence or competence score in chapter UI

gates.original_requirement: Difficulty calibration: items reviewed for challenge and discrimination as sufficient anonymized data accumulates.
gates.scope: No empirical item difficulty/discrimination claim. Difficulty labels and accuracy certificates are not fabricated.
gates.evidence: Original small practice set; no cohort metrics

gates.original_requirement: Feedback source: AI-generated factual critique tied to reviewed materials; unsupported claims flagged to reviewer.
gates.scope: Feedback is authored against the linked sources. No live AI clinical evaluator or unsupported free-form critique is enabled.
gates.evidence: Immutable source-linked explanations; no paid AI endpoint

gates.original_requirement: Test bias: low-English-fluency learners evaluated for comprehension without penalizing legitimate clinical reasoning.
gates.scope: Text-based English notes and choices with hints; language is not independently scored. Comprehension and fairness pilot remain outstanding.

gates.original_requirement: Case transfer: learner applies concepts in new synthetic cases, not only memorized stems.
gates.scope: Synthetic paper cases and comparison examples apply concepts. No patient case management competence is certified.
gates.evidence: apply units and next-day recall units

gates.original_requirement: Rubric agreement: AI evaluation cannot show precise scoring until clinically meaningful human validation passes.
gates.scope: No AI numerical interview/clinical evaluation or precise validated clinical rubric is introduced.

gates.original_requirement: Error reporting: student flags questionable question; review process records response and score correction if needed.
gates.scope: GitHub issue draft includes course/version/unit. Registry withdrawal disables guest and signed-in entry; immutable versions and old scores retained. No automated retrospective score correction is claimed.

gates.original_requirement: Official claims: UPSC details compared to latest notice/corrigenda at time of publication; no predicted RT scheme.
gates.scope: Official source is UPSC portal; no vacancy, date, weightage or official syllabus asserted. Case-specific notices must be checked when an actual requirement is displayed.

gates.original_requirement: Learning pilot: diverse consenting candidate cohort completes usability, comprehension, retrieval and retention tasks. DentPrep | Independent education | Verified-source work handoff
gates.scope: Automated mobile/desktop fixtures and public production guest tests are software acceptance, not a diverse consenting educational pilot.
gates.evidence: CI and public deployment QA evidence; no learning-pilot claim

gates.original_requirement: Graduation gate: no claim that a student is fully exam-ready until broad coverage, repeated evidence and clear caveats exist.
gates.scope: Every package complete_subject:false; reports distinguish first attempts, corrected attempts and recall. No exam readiness, medical competence or selection prediction.
gates.evidence: Course metadata, report and player scope copy
